title: Existence of small semi-vortex solutions for the cubic nonlinear Schrödinger system with Rashba type Spin-Orbit coupling on $\mathbb{R}^2$
summary: We consider the cubic nonlinear Schrödinger system with Rashba type Spin-Orbit Coupling (SOC) on $\mathbb{R}^2$. The system describes SO-coupled spinor BEC in physics. In the literature of physics, the small semi-vortex solutions, small ground state, and the so-called mixed mode, which are mixture of semi-vortex solutions, are investigated. The semi-vortex solutions cause from the resonance on the essential spectrum of the linear operator.
